name: UMass Discovery Camp
operator_name: UMass Amherst Department of Recreation & Wellbeing (Lifelong at UMass)
description_short: Week long day camp for ages 7 to 13 run by UMass Amherst Recreation and Wellbeing, with small groups of up to 10. Campers rotate through science, art, nature and sports activities, go on campus field trips and eat lunch in the UMass dining halls.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations more than 30 days before camp incur a $35 fee; no refunds within 30 days of the start.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp has wrapped up for 2026; 2027 dates and pricing to be announced. 2026 FAQ: Session I August 3 to 7 and Session II August 10 to 14, 8:30 am to 3:30 pm; $350 per child per session, sibling discount $25; aftercare 3:30 to 5:30 pm for $50 per session; daily lunch in UMass dining halls included; ages 7 to 13; location 161 Commonwealth Ave, Amherst, MA 01002. Phone is the RecWell executive director's line listed as the camp contact.

source.title: UMass Discovery Camp : Lifelong at UMass : UMass Amherst

warnings: No 2027 dates or prices yet; this is the 2026 season, which has ended.
